selectedDefinitions.name: Conversion tracking setting accepted customer data terms
selectedDefinitions.description: Whether the customer has accepted customer data terms. If using cross-account conversion tracking, this value is inherited from the manager. This field is read-only. For more information, see https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/7475709.

selectedDefinitions.name: Conversion tracking setting conversion tracking id
selectedDefinitions.description: The conversion tracking id used for this account. This id doesn't indicate whether the customer uses conversion tracking (conversion_tracking_status does). This field is read-only.

selectedDefinitions.name: Conversion tracking setting conversion tracking status
selectedDefinitions.description: Conversion tracking status. It indicates whether the customer is using conversion tracking, and who is the conversion tracking owner of this customer. If this customer is using cross-account conversion tracking, the value returned will differ based on the login-customer-id of the request.

selectedDefinitions.name: Conversion tracking setting cross account conversion tracking id
selectedDefinitions.description: The conversion tracking id of the customer's manager. This is set when the customer is opted into cross account conversion tracking, and it overrides conversion_tracking_id. This field can only be managed through the Google Ads UI. This field is read-only.

result.error: Error calling tool 'get_data': Google Ads cannot return these fields in one request: conversion_action_id has no report in common with the others. Fix: remove conversion_action_id, or request it in a separate call. Guide: https://windsor.ai/documentation/google-ads-fields-cannot-be-queried-together-error/

conversionActionFirstRead.interpretation: Explicit incompatible field combination for conversion_action_id, not an empty report or missing conversion action.

conversionActionCorrectedRead.interpretation: One bounded correction after explicit field incompatibility. No usable returned rows; current action state and event occurrence unknown. No blind further retries.
